steps.what: Count actual usable stocks of appliance parts and identify damaged or missing items
outputs: actual counted quantities and condition findings

steps.what: Compare recorded counts with parts stock levels and existing replenishment limits
inputs: actual counted quantities and condition findings
existing stock records and approved minimum levels
outputs: entered actual counts and proposed replenishment quantities

steps.what: Choose parts replenishment after checking appliance compatibility and upcoming repair needs
inputs: entered actual counts and proposed replenishment quantities
existing service bookings and approved compatible part catalogue

steps.what: Prepare the parts order with exact part numbers, quantities, supplier and delivery details
inputs: existing supplier catalogue, prices and delivery address
outputs: complete final parts order and supplier destination

steps.what: Review and approve the final parts order within existing purchasing authority
inputs: complete final parts order and supplier destination
outputs: approved final parts order and supplier

steps.what: Send the approved replenishment order to the specified parts supplier
inputs: approved final parts order and supplier

steps.what: Inspect received parts, verify actual quantities and put usable stock in its location
inputs: sent parts order and supplier delivery note
outputs: verified actual receipt quantities, condition and storage locations

steps.what: Enter and confirm actual receipt, condition and storage updates in the stock record
inputs: verified actual receipt quantities, condition and storage locations

steps.what: Save the confirmed stock update in the same inventory system

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} stock comparison and {PROCUREMENT} order preparation using repairer-entered actual counts. Send the final approved supplier order through {EMAIL}; retain physical receipt inspection and actual stock updates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock records and supplier delivery notes do not establish actual usable quantities.
tasks.enabler_now: Native minimum-level rules and catalogue-backed order templates can reduce comparison and preparation work.
tasks.still_hard: Choose compatible parts and verify actual receipts.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise damaged stock and likely repair requirements.

ambition.what: Maintain current repair stock with supported administrative work reduced.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify supplier access, purchasing authority and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inventory systems can compare entered counts with minimum levels and populate catalogue-backed orders.

assumptions: OTHER means physical van/workshop stock. s1 supplies actual count and condition; s2 includes entering part ID, location, usable quantity and discrepancy. Only comparison arithmetic shrinks, not counting or count entry. Existing stock owner supplies approved minimum/target levels and part/location mappings; missing rules stay manual.

Existing catalogue owner supplies part number, compatibility, supplier, price/currency and delivery terms. s3 confirms choices; s4 counts any missing order fields. s7 physically verifies actual received quantities and condition, and s8 counts their capture; the delivery note never substitutes for actual receipt.

Native stock rules and order features come first. Central retains 60% of count-entry/comparison and 50% of order preparation and removes a real existing separate email order send. Same-system s9 is approximately zero time and carries no saving. No supplier runtime or delivery labour enters focal savings.

Scenario assumes repairer has authority for routine stock replenishment within existing limits. Other approval requirements must retain their actual labour. s5 approves the finished order and supplier; s8 confirms final stock fields before s9. Edits void approvals.
Provisional B=100, R=84, gross=16; incremental focal rules/catalogue exception upkeep=1; net=15. Shares are illustrative, not measured baselines or means-prior allocations.
unknowns: Existing native coverage, stock-level ownership and purchasing limits.
research_questions: Observe a replenishment cycle and separate actual count capture from comparison and order assembly.

incremental.description: Inspect stock-rule and catalogue mapping exceptions

approvals.approved_version: complete final parts order and specified supplier

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native stock and ordering already cover the work; high allows four additional hours resolving catalogue or count discrepancies beyond central net 15.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test and adjust newly installed appliances

steps.what: Read the appliance model's installation test procedure and acceptance limits
inputs: verified appliance model and installation details

steps.what: Prepare the installed appliance and test equipment for the required operation checks
inputs: actual appliance installation and test equipment

steps.what: Observe and test appliance operation after installation
outputs: actual operating observations and measured test results

steps.what: Make necessary initial installation adjustments based on actual test findings
inputs: actual operating observations and measured test results
outputs: adjusted installation and actual adjustment details

steps.what: Retest adjusted appliance operation and determine whether installation checks pass
inputs: adjusted installation and actual adjustment details
outputs: actual final test readings and pass or unresolved findings

steps.what: Write actual installation test results and adjustment details into the service record
inputs: actual final test readings and pass or unresolved findings

steps.what: Read and approve the final service record against actual readings and adjustments
inputs: actual final test readings and actual adjustment details

steps.what: Save the approved test record in the same service system

tasks.design: Retain physical appliance tests and adjustments at {OTHER}, the installation and test equipment. Try native dictation in the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} service form for actual result entry, with the repairer checking every final value and statement before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service records still need actual observations and adjustment details from the repairer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dictation may reduce manual text entry while preserving source capture and review.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnose abnormal operation and verify an adjustment resolved it.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the appliance in its actual installation and judge safe operation.

build_days.testing_rollout: 2-3; compare dictation accuracy and entry time
build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; verify approved dictation and service-record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native dictation can transcribe a technician's spoken observations into an editable service record.

assumptions: Boundary includes procedure access, physical checks, adjustments, retest and the resulting service record. Test-cycle runtime already automated is excluded from human savings; no shorter attention, adjustment or procedure-reading time is assumed.

Repairer verifies model/job ID and supplies actual test name, reading/unit, pass or unresolved finding and adjustment in s6; dictation time and corrections are included in its retained 70%. Manufacturer supplies applicable procedure and limits, never actual readings. Missing or misheard values require manual entry.

Native form and approved dictation come first; no custom model interprets readings or makes pass decisions. Central is a conditional typing-heavy record scenario, not a claim that all repairers type today. The final whole-record check stays at s7. If direct entry is already quicker or dictation is unavailable, no change is made and saving is zero.

s7 checks the completed record before s8; changes invalidate approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=97.3, gross=2.7; incremental focal dictation vocabulary/error upkeep=1; net=1.7. Shares are illustrative, not measured baselines or means priors.
unknowns: Actual result-entry effort and dictation accuracy for readings, units and part terminology.
research_questions: Compare native dictation with the existing form using real technician-authored test records and include all correction time.

already_counted.description: Final record verification retained at s7

incremental.description: Inspect dictation errors and maintain permitted vocabulary

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where current direct entry beats dictation; high allows 0.7 extra hours correcting misheard readings beyond central net 1.7.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
